# Retail CoD 1.1d dedicated server playerstate under each movement input.
# map mp_carentan, g_gametype dm, joined allies, weapon m1carbine_mp, dedicated 1,
# sv_maxclients 8, sv_pure 0, stock scr_* defaults, one client on the server.
# Captured with tools/run_server.sh and --net-probe --save-motion. Each pose
# holds one usercmd until the state settles, so the values are steady states
# rather than points on a lerp; jump_takeoff is the first snapshot off the
# ground instead, which is where the takeoff velocity is.
# Values are the raw i32 wire words, floats as their bit patterns.
